result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_selected_edge_ids()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get currently selected edge IDs. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L8244-L8275){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_selected_edge_ids() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Get selected edge ids](/assets/graphs/get-selected-edge-ids.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="A grid whose edges are labeled with their ids 1 to 7, with edges 1, 4, and 7 (A–B, B–E, E–F) selected in the accent color. get_selected_edge_ids() returns the list of those ids, 7, 4, 1, in no guaranteed order." width="100%"} Returns the list of edge IDs that are currently marked as selected. Order is not guaranteed. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [list[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : List of selected edge IDs, empty if no edges selected. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} This cycle was created without explicit edge weights, so every edge's `weight` is `None` and the predicate never matches -- the selection comes back empty: ::: {#355632ac .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_cycle_graph(4) .select_edges(lambda e: e.weight is not None and e.weight > 0.5) ) graph.get_selected_edge_ids() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` [] ``` ::: :::
